plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) 'Biochemistry' BA 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/medicine/biochemistry/biochemistry-ba/). Footnotes: 'a': Unified General Education Requirement. 'b': Selected students may be invited to take CHEM 323 or CHEM 324. 'c': Selected students may be invited to take PHYS 123 and PHYS 124 in place of PHYS 121 and PHYS 122. 'd': Students must take two of the three Biochemistry core courses: BIOC 312, BIOC 334, or BIOC 350. For students who take all three courses, the third course can serve as a technical elective. 'e': 3 credit hours of BIOC 391 are required; an additional 3 credit hours of BIOC 391 are required for the Research Honors Concentration. Students should consult their academic advisers about the elective parts of the curriculum. 'f': Each optional concentration is defined by three courses: one of BIOC 312/BIOC 334/BIOC 350 and two technical electives. Students can satisfy the requirements of an optional concentration by choosing their BIOC and technical elective courses appropriately. The exception is the Research Honors concentration, which requires students to apply at the end of their first year. 'or' rows are modeled per convention with choice:true, first option as code, and all options in options[]. Rows combining lecture+lab (e.g. 'EBME 306 & EBME 356') are kept as one combined course with the official combined credit total. Unlabeled credit slots are elective choice placeholders. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions. REPEATED COURSES: BIOC 391 appears in multiple semesters per the official plan. Official plan footnote 'e': '3 credit hours of BIOC 391 are required; an additional 3 credit hours of BIOC 391 are required for the Research Honors Concentration.' allow_repeated_courses is set for this reason.
